card.name: Generic noun ending a noun phrase
card.fires_on: A general head noun such as work, outcome, study, agent, formulation, tool, drug or condition that closes a compound noun phrase. It follows a modifying noun or adjective, as in 'anesthetic agent' or 'database study'.
